nodes.label: Cancelling an event writes no audit trail

nodes.label: Self-serve check-in is a tap from anywhere, not a venue scan
nodes.rationale: self_check_in() has no location check; contained because checkin_modes defaults self_serve false; replacement specified in docs/plans/2026-08-06-venue-scan-checkin-spec.md; build deferred post-Stage 8

nodes.label: No organisation-scoped read of person data / audit log (Q43)
nodes.rationale: By decision Q43 (2026-10-10) person-data tables and audit_events are readable only by the person and the platform operator; a first organiser surface needing them must add a column-limited service_role-only function called after requireStaff and an organisation check

nodes.label: DSR erasure is shallow (pseudonymise_user changes full_name only)
nodes.rationale: pseudonymise_user changes only users.full_name and stamps pseudonymised_at/deleted_at; a 204 must not be read as erased; re-entry before the first real erasure request

nodes.label: M1 cycle caps can only be advisory
nodes.rationale: Eventar sees only part of a practitioner's CPD activity, so only per-event caps are enforceable; never render a cycle figure like 62/90 as true compliance status

nodes.label: PublishDraftButton hard-coded date cause fixed 2026-11-14
nodes.rationale: A second, deterministic cause: the 'asks first' test hard-coded 'Check-in opens at 14 Nov 2026, 08:00'; from 14 Nov 08:00 HKT the component says 'Check-in is open now.' so it failed alone every time; fixed with a pinned clock (vi.useFakeTimers with toFake Date) plus a separate test for the open-now branch; 13/13
